context.description: Step 02c (hard gate): Security review of IDN-05 implementation. New tenant-data-path changes: tenant_role table (per-tenant), GET/POST /roles API endpoints, EE-03 ROLE resolution in task activation.

task.description:
Review the IDN-05 implementation against the numbered security invariants in docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. Focus on:

1. Tenant data isolation: tenant_role rows must be fully isolated to the calling tenant's schema. Verify no cross-tenant leakage is possible in listRoles, upsertRole, and resolveRoleInTx.
2. Field authorisation: GET /roles and POST /roles must require PROCESS_DESIGNER or PLATFORM_ADMIN — verify RBAC check is enforced before any store access.
3. SQL parameterisation: all SQL in role_registry.zig must use parameterised queries (no string interpolation).
4. No catch unreachable on realistic failures: check for any unreachable paths that could be triggered by API input.
5. Sandbox capability gating: not applicable (no Lua), but verify EE-03 ROLE resolution does not expose any capability escalation path.
6. Probe indistinguishability: if group_id not found, POST /roles returns 404 — verify no timing difference reveals whether the group exists in another tenant.
7. Secrets by reference: no secrets in the new code paths.
8. New-path scoping proof: demonstrate that the schema-per-tenant boundary is maintained for the new tenant_role table.

Run: zig build test-integration (or relevant subset) and git diff to verify scope.
Return PASS if all invariants met. FAIL with specific violations if not.

result.summary: All 8 security invariants assessed against IDN-05 implementation. INV-1: tenant_role table created by migration 1154 without schema prefix; lands in tenant schema via search_path; pool sets search_path on checkout; resolveRoleInTx reuses caller transaction conn. lint_migration_schema exits 0. INV-2: RBAC gate (PROCESS_DESIGNER or PLATFORM_ADMIN) is the first statement in both handlers before any store access. Response contains only id/name/group_id/created_at - no privileged-only fields. INV-3: N/A - no Lua/Wasm changes. INV-4: No secret material in new code; no hardcoded credentials; no logging of sensitive fields. INV-5: A group_id from another tenant is not visible in the current tenant schema, returning 404 GROUP_NOT_FOUND identical to a group that never existed. Same DB query path, no timing signal. INV-6: assessed here. INV-7: All SQL uses positional $N params. listRoles has no variable SQL. upsertRole binds group_id as $1::uuid in existence check, name as $1 and group_id as $2::uuid in INSERT. resolveRoleInTx binds name as $1. lint_sql_param_types exits 0. INV-8: No catch unreachable in role_registry.zig or IDN-05 identity.zig additions. EE-03 ROLE resolution: resolveRoleInTx performs a plain DB lookup returning a group UUID; no capability grant or permission escalation - GROUP assignment follows existing IDN-02 rules.

issues.description: tenant_role is not added to BUSINESS_TABLES in tools/lint_migration_schema.py. The current migration is correct (no public. prefix, lands in tenant schema via search_path), but the linter will not catch a future migration placing public.tenant_role. Follow-up: add tenant_role to the BUSINESS_TABLES list in tools/lint_migration_schema.py.

In src/main.zig the actor fallback for /roles route defaults to TASK_WORKER (dead code: auth gate always ensures authenticated_ctx is non-null before this branch executes). Benign because the handler RBAC check rejects TASK_WORKER, but creates inconsistency with the /services route which defaults to PLATFORM_ADMIN. No security impact; cleanup optional.

No integration-level test asserting byte-equality between GROUP_NOT_FOUND (404) for a cross-tenant group_id probe and GROUP_NOT_FOUND (404) for a never-existed group_id. INV-5 is satisfied by design (same DB query path, same schema), but per security-invariants.md a dedicated response-equality test is the natural gap to close as a follow-up.
